name: JUSD
oneLiner: JUSD is an issuer-managed dollar stablecoin with crypto collateral and protocol-managed reserve liquidity; redemption backstop is not source-verified by Pharos.
collateral: Self-described "diversified reserve of high-quality assets" managed by the issuer; the 2023 whitepaper claims supply is minted/burned as the issuer adds or reduces backing assets but names no specific reserve assets, custodians, or amounts and publishes no attestation.
pegMechanism: Dollar stable token with issuer/protocol-managed collateral and liquidity processes described by JUSD; no Pharos redemption backstop is modeled until the exit route is source-reviewed

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: JUSD is native on Polygon, while the BSC deployment is a Chainport-bridged BridgeMintableToken with minting gated by classified authority / Chainport-controlled admin infrastructure. Because durable BSC supply depends on a third-party bridge mint route, Pharos scores the route as external lock/mint exposure.

mintAuthority.summary: JUSD BSC is a BridgeMintableToken proxy; minting requires a 'classified authority' role — the ProxyAdmin is owned by ChainportCongress (0xb6b4c7ac, named 'ChainportCongress'). JUSD Polygon is Ownable with EOA owner 0x7be44b5d (confirmed). BSC bridge authority role holder is not enumerable on-chain without the Chainport contract ABI.

controls.label: JUSD Polygon — issuer EOA owner
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 88341894: JUSD proxy at 0x0ba8a6ce (no proxy admin slot — not upgradeable proxy). owner() returns 0x7be44b5d470d1cdea8703b6c5156267d4b22a42f. eth_getCode(0x7be44b5d) = 0x (confirmed EOA). Reverts on mint call with 'Ownable: caller is not the owner'.

controls.label: JUSD BSC — Chainport bridge authority (ProxyAdmin: ChainportCongress)
controls.evidence: At BSC block 103800563: JUSD BSC proxy at 0xbf3950db is a TransparentUpgradeableProxy with impl 0x877d233c (BridgeMintableToken — confirmed via revert message 'BridgeMintableToken: Function can be called only by a classified authority.'). ProxyAdmin = 0xe317bf1c; ProxyAdmin.owner() = 0xb6b4c7ac240b1f176c5589d064733066a83884a1 (contract named 'ChainportCongress'). The Chainport bridge authority holding the mint role on BSC is not enumerable without the Chainport contract ABI.

review.evidence: At BSC block 103800563 and Polygon block 88341894: JUSD Polygon owner confirmed as EOA 0x7be44b5d (bytecode=0x). JUSD BSC is a BridgeMintableToken with minting gated by 'classified authority' — the ProxyAdmin is controlled by ChainportCongress (contract 0xb6b4c7ac). JUSD's architecture links it to the Chainport bridge protocol; the specific bridge minter role address is not publicly enumerable on-chain without the Chainport contract interface. Reserve backing remains unverified.
unresolvedQuestions: Enumerate the live Chainport bridge authority address holding the classified-authority mint role on BSC (requires Chainport contract ABI or event log scan on ChainportCongress).
